SELECT
    rc.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY rc.loan_id;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown
WHERE status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
ORDER BY loan_id;

SELECT
    payment_id,
    business_date,
    amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC, payment_id;

SELECT
    pp.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
FROM
    person_profile pp
WHERE
    pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY
    pp.annual_income DESC,
    pp.party_id;

SELECT
    card_id,
    issued_on,
    expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on, card_id;

SELECT
    op.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM organization_profile op
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
WHERE ou.region_code = (
    SELECT ou2.region_code
    FROM organization_unit ou2
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ou2.institution_id
    WHERE i.institution_name = '上海分行'
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY op.party_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY account_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT
    is.sector_name_zh,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_sector is ON is.sector_code = op.industry_code
GROUP BY is.sector_code, is.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, is.sector_name_zh;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS total_fair_value
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY total_fair_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = p.home_org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY relation_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(abs(ABS(lbs.ledger_balance))), 2) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_deposit_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY avg_overdue_days DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    cs.net_capital
ORDER BY
    exposure_ratio DESC,
    eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT
    isp.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonperforming_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(ld.loan_id), 6) AS nonperforming_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_sector isp ON isp.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY isp.sector_code, isp.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY nonperforming_ratio DESC, industry_name;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
    p.display_name AS party_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, ca.borrower_party_id
LIMIT 15;

SELECT
    wp.risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(wp.management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
GROUP BY wp.risk_level
ORDER BY wp.risk_level ASC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC, guarantor_id;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(dse.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 dse
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = dse.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_records
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_records DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    ds.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = ds.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ds.loan_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_balance
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name,
    s.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id;

WITH payment_inst AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.instruction_id,
        pi.instruction_amount,
        pi.intended_payee_party_id,
        ca.institution_id
    FROM payment_instruction pi
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
),
inst_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(instruction_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM payment_inst
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
inst_violations AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.institution_id,
        SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS violation_amount
    FROM payment_inst pi
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
    WHERE s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
    GROUP BY pi.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(iv.violation_amount, 0) AS violation_amount,
    it.total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(iv.violation_amount, 0) * 1.0 / it.total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM inst_totals it
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = it.institution_id
LEFT JOIN inst_violations iv ON iv.institution_id = it.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on,
    wp.actual_termination_on
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC, wp.product_id, ma.asset_id;

WITH guarantor_counts AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COALESCE(gc.guarantee_count, 0) AS guarantee_count,
    COALESCE(bc.agreement_count, 0) AS agreement_count
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_counts gc ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN borrower_counts bc ON bc.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY guarantee_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    op.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    ca_target.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_sector ca_target ON ca_target.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code != ca.target_industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    pa_party.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    ra_party.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account pa ON pe.from_account_id = pa.account_id
JOIN account ra ON pe.to_account_id = ra.account_id
JOIN account_holder pa_holder ON pa_holder.account_id = pa.account_id AND pa_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder ra_holder ON ra_holder.account_id = ra.account_id AND ra_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party pa_party ON pa_party.party_id = pa_holder.party_id
JOIN party ra_party ON ra_party.party_id = ra_holder.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = pa_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ra_party.party_id)
                     OR (pr.source_party_id = ra_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = pa_party.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = acc.institution_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    so.staff_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON so.operator_id = pe.operator_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = to_acc.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
WHERE s.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY so.staff_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, so.staff_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    cdd.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cdd.event_date,
    cdd.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cdd.institution_id
WHERE cdd.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY days_diff DESC, cdd.record_id
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    cl.security_id,
    cl.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY cl.security_id;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS balance_rank
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    balance_rank
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE balance_rank = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_balance_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        s.sector_name_zh,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.sector_name_zh ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS rank_in_sector
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = a.borrower_party_id
    JOIN industry_sector s ON s.sector_code = op.industry_code
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    sector_name_zh,
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    rank_in_sector
FROM loan_balance_ranked
WHERE rank_in_sector <= 3
ORDER BY sector_name_zh, rank_in_sector;

WITH daily_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
SELECT 
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM daily_counts
ORDER BY business_date;

WITH institution_avg AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        ROUND(AVG(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN institution_avg ia ON ia.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > ia.avg_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND sa.security_id NOT IN (
      SELECT cl.security_id
      FROM collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
        ELSE '360天以上'
    END AS overdue_interval,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY overdue_interval
ORDER BY
    CASE overdue_interval
        WHEN '未逾期' THEN 0
        WHEN '1-30天' THEN 1
        WHEN '31-90天' THEN 2
        WHEN '91-180天' THEN 3
        WHEN '181-360天' THEN 4
        WHEN '360天以上' THEN 5
    END ASC;

SELECT
    cv.collateral_id,
    cv.valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM collateral_valuation cv
GROUP BY cv.collateral_id, cv.valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY cv.collateral_id;

WITH customer_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
        ROUND(AVG(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS avg_loan_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE a.borrower_party_id IN (
        SELECT party_id FROM party WHERE party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    )
    GROUP BY a.borrower_party_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        cls.borrower_party_id,
        cls.loan_count,
        cls.total_principal_balance,
        cls.avg_loan_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cls.avg_loan_amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_loan_stats cls
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name,
    rc.loan_count,
    rc.total_principal_balance,
    rc.avg_loan_amount
FROM ranked_customers rc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = rc.borrower_party_id
WHERE rc.rn <= 5

SELECT

SELECT

WITH payment_base AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.amount,
        pe.from_account_id,
        pe.to_account_id,
        pe.business_date,
        -- 确定归属机构：优先付款账户开户机构，无则取收款账户开户机构
        COALESCE(
            (SELECT a1.institution_id FROM account a1 WHERE a1.account_id = pe.from_account_id),
            (SELECT a2.institution_id FROM account a2 WHERE a2.account_id = pe.to_account_id)
        ) AS institution_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
),
account_holders AS (
    -- 获取账户的主持有人
    SELECT 
        ah.account_id,
        ah.party_id AS holder_party_id
    FROM account_holder ah
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, MIN(effective_from) AS min_eff
        FROM account_holder
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) latest ON ah.account_id = latest.account_id AND ah.effective_from = latest.min_eff
    WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
),
payment_with_parties AS (
    SELECT 
        pb.*,
        ah_from.holder_party_id AS from_party_id,
        ah_to.holder_party_id AS to_party_id
    FROM payment_base pb
    LEFT JOIN account_holders ah_from ON pb.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holders ah_to ON pb.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
),
related_check AS (
    SELECT 
        pwp.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN pwp.from_party_id IS NOT NULL AND pwp.to_party_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 
                     FROM party_relation pr 
                     WHERE pr.source_party_id = pwp.from_party_id 
                       AND pr.target_party_id = pwp.to_party_id
                       AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
                 ) 
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS is_related
    FROM payment_with_parties pwp
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rc.is_related = 1 THEN rc.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(rc.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rc.is_related = 1 THEN rc.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(rc.amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM related_check rc
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = rc.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_account_count
FROM party p
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = acc.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND acc.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY
    term_deposit_account_count DESC,
    p.party_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs

)
SELECT

ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC

WITH industry_balance AS (

        ip.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,

    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id

),
total_balance AS (

    FROM industry_balance
),
ranked_industries AS (
    SELECT 
        ib.industry_name,
        ib.balance_sum,
        ROUND(SUM(ib.balance_sum) OVER (ORDER BY ib.balance_sum DESC) * 1.0 / tb.total_bal, 6) AS cumulative_ratio

)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    balance_sum,
    cumulative_ratio
FROM ranked_industries
WHERE cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC, industry_name;

SELECT

JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valued_on = (
    SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
    FROM collateral_valuation cv2
    WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
)

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS institution_count
FROM account a
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = a.account_id -- 注意：account表没有直接的party_id，需要通过account_holder关联
-- 修正：account表没有party_id，需要通过account_holder表关联party
SELECT

SELECT

SELECT

JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id

SELECT

SELECT
    i.institution_name,

FROM loan_drawdown ld

SELECT

SELECT

FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
