WITH inst_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        AVG(lbs.principal_balance) AS avg_bal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(ia.avg_bal, 2) AS avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - ia.avg_bal, 2) AS gap
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN inst_avg ia ON ia.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 2 * ia.avg_bal
ORDER BY gap DESC, ld.loan_id;

WITH inst_total AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
inst_non_related AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS non_related_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.target_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
        WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    )
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) AS non_related_amount,
    it.total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) * 1.0 / it.total_amount, 6) AS ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN inst_total it ON i.institution_id = it.institution_id
LEFT JOIN inst_non_related nra ON i.institution_id = nra.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
capital_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        ROUND(net_capital, 2) AS net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
concentration AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        lt.total_loan_balance,
        ct.net_capital,
        ROUND(lt.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / ct.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
    FROM loan_totals lt
    JOIN capital_totals ct ON ct.institution_id = lt.institution_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = lt.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = lt.borrower_party_id
    WHERE ct.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    total_loan_balance,
    net_capital,
    concentration_ratio
FROM concentration
WHERE concentration_ratio > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC, institution_name, customer_name
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.target_industry_code,
        ROUND(AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate), 4) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate,
    ia.avg_rate AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate, 2) AS rate_up_premium_pct
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN industry_avg_rate ia ON ca.target_industry_code = ia.target_industry_code
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ia.avg_rate > 0
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate > 10
ORDER BY rate_up_premium_pct DESC, ca.agreement_id;

WITH loan_balance_latest AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
capital_latest AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
borrower_loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbl.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_latest lbl ON ld.loan_id = lbl.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
exceeding_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        blt.institution_id,
        blt.borrower_party_id,
        blt.total_loan_balance,
        cl.net_capital,
        blt.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / cl.net_capital AS ratio
    FROM borrower_loan_totals blt
    JOIN capital_latest cl ON blt.institution_id = cl.institution_id
    WHERE cl.net_capital > 0
      AND blt.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / cl.net_capital > 0.1
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS exceeding_customer_count
FROM exceeding_customers ec
JOIN institution i ON ec.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY exceeding_customer_count DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        SUM(lds.principal_balance) AS total_exposure
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lds ON lds.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    -- 假设取最新或特定快照，通常监管报表取最近一期，这里取最新的一条或指定日期
    -- 由于题目未指定具体哪一期，且capital_snapshot有唯一约束(institution_id, as_of_date, currency_code)，
    -- 假设只有一种货币或取最大值，这里简化为取该日期的记录。
    -- 如果有多种货币，通常监管口径会指定本币，这里假设currency_code为'CNY'或取总和，
    -- 但schema中net_capital是REAL，且uq包含currency_code。
    -- 为严谨，我们假设只有一种主要货币或题目隐含本币。
    -- 若需处理多币种，通常需转换。此处按单币种或默认处理，若无过滤则取所有？
    -- 参考示例中未做币种过滤，但通常集中度计算需同币种。
    -- 这里假设取该机构在该日期的所有资本净额之和，或者假设只有一条。
    -- 更稳妥的是取该日期的记录，若有多条货币，通常监管要求折算为本币。
    -- 鉴于schema限制，我们直接取该日期的记录。
    GROUP BY institution_id, net_capital
)
SELECT 
    ge.exposure_group_id,
    ge.group_name,
    ROUND(ge.total_exposure, 2) AS total_exposure,
    ROUND(gc.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(ge.total_exposure * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM group_exposure ge
JOIN group_capital gc ON gc.institution_id = ge.institution_id
WHERE gc.net_capital > 0
HAVING ge.total_exposure * 1.0 / gc.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.loan_account_id AS disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_interval
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.loan_account_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
  AND pe.business_date <= date(ld.disbursed_on, '+7 days')
ORDER BY days_interval ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.currency_code = 'CNY' -- 假设主要币种为CNY，若需多币种需进一步处理，通常监管报表以本位币或统一折算
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lb.total_principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_balance lb ON ca.agreement_id = lb.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
borrower_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        be.institution_id,
        be.borrower_party_id,
        ROUND(be.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
    FROM borrower_exposure be
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON be.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
),
ranked_borrowers AS (
    SELECT 
        br.institution_id,
        br.borrower_party_id,
        br.exposure_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY br.institution_id ORDER BY br.exposure_ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM borrower_ratio br
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    rb.exposure_ratio
FROM ranked_borrowers rb
JOIN institution i ON rb.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON rb.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE rb.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS tier
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    tier
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY tier ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH loan_inst_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id) AS inst_total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        institution_name,
        principal_balance,
        ROUND(principal_balance * 100.0 / inst_total_principal, 2) AS ratio_percent,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY principal_balance * 1.0 / inst_total_principal DESC) AS rnk
    FROM loan_inst_balance
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    institution_name,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ratio_percent
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE rnk <= 300
ORDER BY institution_name ASC, ratio_percent DESC, loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_overdue_stats AS (
    SELECT
        rs.loan_id,
        COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_count,
        SUM(rs.principal_due) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
    GROUP BY rs.loan_id
)
SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    ROUND(los.total_overdue_principal, 2) AS total_overdue_principal,
    los.overdue_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_overdue_stats los ON ld.loan_id = los.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND los.overdue_count >= 2
ORDER BY los.overdue_count DESC, los.total_overdue_principal DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS loan_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on AS disbursement_date,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC,
    loan_account_id,
    disbursement_date
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    t1.party_id
FROM (
    -- 持有定期存款的账户持有人
    SELECT ah.party_id
    FROM account_holder ah
    JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
    WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    GROUP BY ah.party_id
) t1
INTERSECT
SELECT
    t2.party_id
FROM (
    -- 签署过授信合同的借款人
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) t2
ORDER BY party_id;

SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'STAFF'
  AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND p.party_id NOT IN (
      SELECT ah.party_id
      FROM account_holder ah
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
      SELECT pe.from_account_id
      FROM payment_event pe
      JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
      WHERE ptc.name_zh = '现金支取'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    gc.security_id,
    gc.guaranteed_amount
FROM
    guarantor_commitment gc
WHERE
    gc.status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    gc.commitment_id;

WITH loan_dates AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        current_maturity_on,
        julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) AS remaining_days
    FROM loan_drawdown
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
),
loan_buckets AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        CASE
            WHEN remaining_days < 0 THEN '已到期'
            WHEN remaining_days >= 0 AND remaining_days <= 90 THEN '临期'
            ELSE '常态'
        END AS bucket
    FROM loan_dates
)
SELECT
    bucket AS bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_buckets
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY
    CASE bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY link_count DESC, cl.collateral_id;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC, ca.collateral_type;

WITH loan_repayment_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        repayment_account_id,
        loan_id,
        disbursed_on,
        disbursed_amount,
        loan_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repayment_account_id ORDER BY disbursed_on, loan_id) AS rn
    FROM loan_repayment_stats
    WHERE loan_count >= 3
)
SELECT 
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    ROUND(disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    loan_count
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id, disbursed_on, loan_id;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 账户数量,
    ROUND(SUM(ABS(lbs.ledger_balance - lbs.available_balance)), 2) AS 差额合计
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.ledger_balance > lbs.available_balance
  AND (lbs.ledger_balance - lbs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 差额合计 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM account a
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT
    pc.card_id,
    ct.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    pc.issued_on
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ct ON ct.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE pc.issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY pc.issued_on, pc.card_id;

WITH payment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS entrusted_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS self_payment_amount,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.payment_mode IN ('ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT', 'SELF_PAYMENT')
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(ps.entrusted_amount, 2) AS entrusted_amount,
    ROUND(ps.self_payment_amount, 2) AS self_payment_amount,
    ROUND(ps.entrusted_amount * 1.0 / ps.total_amount, 6) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM payment_stats ps
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ps.institution_id
WHERE ps.entrusted_amount * 1.0 / ps.total_amount < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

WITH contract_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        agreement_id,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
)
SELECT 
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    ct.total_disbursed AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / ct.total_disbursed, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN contract_totals ct ON ld.agreement_id = ct.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / ct.total_disbursed > 90
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    inst.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'TERMINATED' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 计划募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'TERMINATED' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 6) AS 完成率
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution inst ON inst.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY inst.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'TERMINATED' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) > 1.2
ORDER BY 完成率 DESC;

WITH borrower_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 END) AS overdue_count,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    bls.overdue_count,
    bls.total_count
FROM borrower_loan_stats bls
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = bls.borrower_party_id
WHERE bls.overdue_count > 0
  AND bls.total_count > bls.overdue_count
ORDER BY bls.overdue_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    ROUND(pi.instruction_amount, 2) AS instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON borrower.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_installments AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.loan_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_installments,
        SUM(rs.principal_due) AS total_principal_due,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_installments
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    GROUP BY rs.loan_id
)
SELECT 
    li.loan_id,
    li.total_installments AS 未结清期次数,
    ROUND(li.total_principal_due, 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM loan_installments li
WHERE li.paid_installments = 0
ORDER BY li.total_principal_due DESC, li.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    ROUND(b.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(b.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot b ON b.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE l.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND b.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND b.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY b.principal_balance DESC, l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on, ld.loan_id;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.security_type AS 担保方式,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH institution_product_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ROUND(AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate), 4) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
),
related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pr.target_party_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
    WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
      AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
      AND pr.confidence_level = 'HIGH'
),
target_contracts AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.annual_interest_rate,
        ca.product_family,
        ca.institution_id,
        p.display_name AS borrower_name
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN related_borrowers rb ON rb.target_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    tc.borrower_name,
    tc.borrower_party_id,
    tc.annual_interest_rate,
    ipa.avg_rate,
    ROUND(tc.annual_interest_rate - ipa.avg_rate, 4) AS rate_gap
FROM target_contracts tc
JOIN institution_product_avg ipa 
    ON ipa.institution_id = tc.institution_id 
    AND ipa.product_family = tc.product_family
WHERE tc.annual_interest_rate < ipa.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_gap DESC, tc.borrower_party_id, tc.agreement_id;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id AS source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id AS target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh AS relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
  )
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh, pr.relation_id;

WITH group_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS loan_balance_sum
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id AND ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE eg.effective_to IS NULL OR eg.effective_to >= '2026-06-30'
      AND egm.effective_to IS NULL OR egm.effective_to >= '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE eg.effective_to IS NULL OR eg.effective_to >= '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    glb.group_name,
    glb.member_count,
    glb.loan_balance_sum,
    gc.net_capital,
    ROUND(glb.loan_balance_sum * 1.0 / gc.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
FROM group_loan_balance glb
JOIN group_capital gc ON gc.exposure_group_id = glb.exposure_group_id
WHERE gc.net_capital > 0
  AND (glb.loan_balance_sum * 1.0 / gc.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account payer_acc ON pe.from_account_id = payer_acc.account_id
JOIN account payee_acc ON pe.to_account_id = payee_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder payer_holder ON payer_holder.account_id = payer_acc.account_id AND payer_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder payee_holder ON payee_holder.account_id = payee_acc.account_id AND payee_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party payer ON payer.party_id = payer_holder.party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = payee_holder.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = payer.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payee.party_id)
                     OR (pr.source_party_id = payee.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payer.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC, payer.display_name, payee.display_name;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id;

SELECT
    phs.product_id,
    COUNT(phs.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
GROUP BY phs.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, phs.product_id
LIMIT 20;

WITH loan_overdue_stats AS (
    SELECT
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        lbs.overdue_principal,
        MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
      AND lbs.overdue_principal IS NOT NULL
      AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY lbs.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance, lbs.overdue_principal
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    max_overdue_days
FROM loan_overdue_stats
WHERE max_overdue_days >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, loan_id;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS 涉及机构数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 取得授信的成员数
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 涉及机构数 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lds.party_id) AS 逾期成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(lds.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lds ON lds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE lds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_guarantees AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(g.total_guarantee_amount, 2) AS 对外担保合计,
    ROUND(l.total_loan_amount, 2) AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(g.total_guarantee_amount - l.total_loan_amount, 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN borrower_loans l ON l.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN guarantor_guarantees g ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND g.total_guarantee_amount > l.total_loan_amount
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    sm.staff_id AS staff_id,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY agreement_count DESC, sm.staff_id;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC, p.party_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_agreement_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_CLERK'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    p.display_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level
ORDER BY
    self_loan_agreement_count DESC,
    so.operator_id;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'STAFF'
  AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

WITH borrower_repayment AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_repayment
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id IN (
        SELECT party_id FROM party WHERE party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    )
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
borrower_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        borrower_party_id,
        SUM(total_repayment) AS total_repayment_sum
    FROM borrower_repayment
    GROUP BY borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(bt.total_repayment_sum, 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(bt.total_repayment_sum * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM borrower_totals bt
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = bt.borrower_party_id
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = bt.borrower_party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 0
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    lpc.product_family AS 产品类别名称,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_code = ld.drawdown_type
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_family
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, 产品类别名称;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= '2026-09-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_days_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > '2026-09-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS beyond_90_days_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH joint_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT party_id) AS holder_count
    FROM account_holder
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT party_id) > 1
)
SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(*) AS joint_account_count
FROM joint_accounts ja
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ja.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(lbs.loan_id) AS 逾期笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id AS 贷款编号,
    COUNT(*) AS 逾期期数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC, rs.loan_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_overdue_interest
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS 逾期贷款数
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY 逾期贷款数 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    rs.installment_no,
    rs.principal_due,
    rs.interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND rs.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY rs.principal_due DESC, rs.loan_id, rs.installment_no;

WITH inst_limits AS (
    SELECT
        cf.institution_id,
        SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit
    FROM credit_facility cf
    GROUP BY cf.institution_id
),
inst_disbursements AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
inst_capital AS (
    SELECT
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(il.total_limit, 2) AS total_limit,
    ROUND(id.total_disbursed, 2) AS total_disbursed,
    ROUND(ic.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(id.total_disbursed * 1.0 / ic.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN inst_limits il ON il.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN inst_disbursements id ON id.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN inst_capital ic ON ic.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE id.total_disbursed > ic.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS 保证人个数,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN status_catalog sc
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement'
    AND sc.status_code = cf.status
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC, cf.facility_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cf.facility_type AS 授信类型代码,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信限额合计
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY 授信限额合计 DESC, i.institution_name, cf.facility_type;

SELECT
    cf.facility_type,
    COUNT(cf.facility_id) AS facility_count
FROM credit_facility cf
WHERE cf.limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY cf.facility_type
ORDER BY facility_count DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pmc.payment_mode = ld.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        wp.product_id,
        wp.planned_raise_amount,
        wp.actual_raise_amount,
        wp.minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY wp.actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_id
    FROM wealth_product wp
    WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
)
SELECT 
    group_id,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM ranked_products
WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
GROUP BY group_id
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY group_id ASC;

SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh;

SELECT
    it.name_zh AS 融资工具中文名称,
    sc.name_zh AS 实体状态中文名称
FROM
    instrument_type_catalog it
CROSS JOIN
    status_catalog sc
WHERE
    sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY
    it.name_zh,
    sc.name_zh;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sa.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = sa.staff_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_manager_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

select
  ls.loan_id,
  cg.grade_name_zh,
  ls.principal_overdue_days,
  ls.overdue_principal
from delinquency_snapshot ls
join risk_classification rc on rc.loan_id = ls.loan_id
join classification_grade cg on cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
where ls.principal_overdue_days > 30
  and cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
order by ls.principal_overdue_days desc, ls.loan_id

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS 借据笔数
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE
    ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.provision_stage = '2'
    AND ps.recognized_amount / ps.required_amount < 0.5
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    借据笔数 DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS 拨备缺口合计
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY 拨备缺口合计 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    b.ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot b
    ON a.account_id = b.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder h
    ON a.account_id = h.account_id
    AND h.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
    AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND h.account_holder_id IS NULL
    AND b.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY b.ledger_balance DESC, a.account_id;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
    COUNT(*) AS 客户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, p.customer_segment;

SELECT
    ma.asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
INNER JOIN industry_sector isec
    ON ma.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, ma.asset_category_primary;

WITH client_credit AS (
    SELECT
        cf.obligor_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit
    FROM credit_facility cf
    WHERE cf.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cf.obligor_party_id
),
client_income AS (
    SELECT
        pp.party_id,
        pp.annual_income
    FROM person_profile pp
    WHERE pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL AND pp.annual_income > 0
)
SELECT
    cc.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ci.annual_income AS 年收入,
    cc.total_credit_limit AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(cc.total_credit_limit * 1.0 / ci.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM client_credit cc
JOIN client_income ci ON ci.party_id = cc.party_id
WHERE cc.total_credit_limit * 1.0 / ci.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, cc.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, pp.occupation_code ASC, pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT
    status AS card_status,
    COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY issue_count DESC, status;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, 营业单元名称;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id, pc.card_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_txn_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY cash_txn_count DESC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id AS holder_party_id,
    COUNT(pc.card_id) AS card_count
FROM payment_card pc
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pc.card_id) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, pc.holder_party_id;

SELECT
    ct.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ct ON pc.card_type = ct.card_type
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND ct.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
GROUP BY ct.card_type, ct.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, ct.name_zh;

SELECT
    pe.channel,
    COUNT(*) AS payment_cnt,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event pe
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.is_cash = 0
GROUP BY pe.channel
HAVING AVG(pe.amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, pe.channel;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC, td.account_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS highest_valuation_amount
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY highest_valuation_amount DESC, ca.collateral_id;

select
  ca.collateral_id,
  ca.asset_label,
  count(cl.collateral_link_id) as 被引用次数,
  count(distinct cl.security_id) as 关联担保合同数
from collateral_asset ca
join collateral_link cl on cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
where ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  and cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
group by ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
having count(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
order by 被引用次数 desc, ca.collateral_id

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
guarantor_details AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        gc.security_id,
        gc.guaranteed_amount,
        gc.agreement_id,
        p.display_name AS guarantor_name
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    JOIN secured_obligation so ON gc.security_id = so.security_id AND sa.institution_id = so.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND so.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    gd.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号,
    gd.guarantor_name AS 保证人名称,
    gd.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(gd.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额,
    ROUND(lt.total_disbursed, 2) AS 该合同实际放款总金额
FROM guarantor_details gd
JOIN loan_totals lt ON gd.agreement_id = lt.agreement_id
WHERE gd.guaranteed_amount > lt.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gd.guaranteed_amount DESC, gd.guarantor_party_id ASC, gd.agreement_id ASC;

select
  ca.agreement_id as 授信合同编号,
  ca.borrower_party_id as 债务人编号,
  ca.contract_amount as 授信合同金额,
  round(coalesce(sum(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) as 担保覆盖合计,
  round(ca.contract_amount - coalesce(sum(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) as 保障缺口
from credit_agreement ca
left join secured_obligation so
  on so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
  and so.effective_from <= '2026-06-30'
  and (so.effective_to is null or so.effective_to > '2026-06-30')
where ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
group by ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
having ca.contract_amount > coalesce(sum(so.covered_amount), 0)
order by 保障缺口 desc, ca.agreement_id
limit 100

with substandard_loans as (
    select rc.loan_id, rc.as_of_date, cg.grade_name_zh
    from risk_classification rc
    join classification_grade cg on cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
    where cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
),
provision_deficit as (
    select sl.loan_id, sl.grade_name_zh, ps.required_amount, ps.recognized_amount
    from substandard_loans sl
    join provision_snapshot ps on ps.loan_id = sl.loan_id and ps.as_of_date = sl.as_of_date
    where ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
),
loan_institution as (
    select pd.loan_id, ca.institution_id
    from loan_drawdown pd
    join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = pd.agreement_id
)
select i.institution_name, pd.grade_name_zh, count(*) as 拨备不足借据笔数
from provision_deficit pd
join loan_institution li on li.loan_id = pd.loan_id
join institution i on i.institution_id = li.institution_id
group by i.institution_name, pd.grade_name_zh
order by 拨备不足借据笔数 desc, i.institution_name

with loan_latest as (
    select
        loan_id,
        principal_balance
    from loan_balance_snapshot
    where as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
agreement_amount as (
    select
        agreement_id,
        contract_amount
    from credit_agreement
    where status = 'ACTIVE'
)
select
    a.borrower_party_id,
    l.loan_id,
    ll.principal_balance,
    aa.contract_amount,
    round(ll.principal_balance * 1.0 / aa.contract_amount, 2) as 余额倍数
from loan_latest ll
join loan_drawdown l on l.loan_id = ll.loan_id
join agreement_amount aa on aa.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
where ll.principal_balance >= aa.contract_amount * 4
order by 余额倍数 desc, l.loan_id asc

with excess as (
  select
    ca.institution_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ps.loan_id,
    ps.recognized_amount,
    ps.required_amount,
    ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount as excess_amount
  from provision_snapshot ps
  join loan_drawdown ld on ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
  join credit_agreement ca on ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
  join risk_classification rc on rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id and rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  join classification_grade cg on cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
  where ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    and cg.is_nonperforming = 1
    and ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
)
select
  i.institution_name,
  e.grade_name_zh,
  count(*) as 多计提笔数,
  round(sum(e.excess_amount), 2) as 多计提金额合计
from excess e
join institution i on i.institution_id = e.institution_id
group by i.institution_name, e.grade_name_zh
order by 多计提金额合计 desc, i.institution_name, e.grade_name_zh

WITH internal_max AS (
    SELECT 
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal_valuation
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
external_max AS (
    SELECT 
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external_valuation
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_valuation, 2) AS max_internal_valuation,
    ROUND(em.max_external_valuation, 2) AS max_external_valuation,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_valuation - em.max_external_valuation, 2) AS valuation_difference
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN internal_max im ON ca.collateral_id = im.collateral_id
JOIN external_max em ON ca.collateral_id = em.collateral_id
WHERE im.max_internal_valuation > em.max_external_valuation
ORDER BY valuation_difference DESC, ca.collateral_id;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT 
        cv.collateral_id,
        cv.valuation_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cv.collateral_id ORDER BY cv.valued_on DESC) as rn
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
),
pledge_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        cl.collateral_id,
        SUM(cl.pledged_amount) as total_pledged
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
)
SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    lv.valuation_amount,
    ps.total_pledged,
    ROUND(ps.total_pledged - lv.valuation_amount, 2) as coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN latest_valuation lv ON ca.collateral_id = lv.collateral_id AND lv.rn = 1
JOIN pledge_summary ps ON ca.collateral_id = ps.collateral_id
WHERE lv.valuation_amount < ps.total_pledged
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS own_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_guarantees AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(bl.own_loan_amount, 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(gg.total_guarantee_amount, 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM guarantor_guarantees gg
JOIN borrower_loans bl ON gg.guarantor_party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
JOIN party p ON gg.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gg.total_guarantee_amount > bl.own_loan_amount
ORDER BY gg.total_guarantee_amount DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.is_public_official = 1
    AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    egt.name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog egt ON egt.group_type = eg.group_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, egt.group_type, egt.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY member_count DESC, i.institution_name, egt.name_zh;

SELECT
    egm.party_id AS 成员客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 成员客户编号 ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.target_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COALESCE(src_loan.cnt, 0) AS 一主体现有借款合同数,
    COALESCE(tgt_loan.cnt, 0) AS 另一主体现有借款合同数
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) src_loan ON src_loan.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) tgt_loan ON tgt_loan.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
ORDER BY (COALESCE(src_loan.cnt, 0) + COALESCE(tgt_loan.cnt, 0)) DESC, pr.relation_id;

SELECT
  ca.collateral_id,
  ca.asset_label,
  ca.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset ca
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
      AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY ca.collateral_id ASC

WITH guarantor_effective AS (
    -- 统计每个担保人有效的保证承诺金额合计
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    -- 统计每个借款人（作为借据持有人）在当前快照日的贷款本金余额合计
    -- 注意：题目要求“自身贷款敞口取其作为借款人名下借据的当前本金余额合计”
    -- 借据 loan_drawdown 关联授信协议 credit_agreement 获取 borrower_party_id
    -- 余额取 loan_balance_snapshot 在审计基准日 '2026-06-30' 的数据
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ge.total_guaranteed_amount AS 有效保证责任合计,
    COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(ge.total_guaranteed_amount - COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_effective ge
JOIN party p ON ge.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN borrower_exposure be ON ge.guarantor_party_id = be.borrower_party_id
WHERE ge.total_guaranteed_amount > COALESCE(be.total_loan_balance, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC, p.party_id;

WITH borrower_with_overdue AS (
    -- 找出存在本金逾期借据的借款人（通过借据关联到授信协议，再找到借款人）
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
      AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
guarantors_of_overdue_borrowers AS (
    -- 找出上述借款人的有效保证人
    SELECT DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id IN (SELECT borrower_party_id FROM borrower_with_overdue)
      AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount,
    'ACTIVE' AS guarantee_status
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE p.party_id IN (SELECT guarantor_party_id FROM guarantors_of_overdue_borrowers)
  AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    ma.asset_name AS 底层资产名称,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS 最终债务人编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND lb.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY
    产品名称 ASC,
    逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(sa.security_id) AS security_count,
    ROUND(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 2) AS total_secured_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY total_secured_amount DESC, sa.security_type;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name,
    ca.contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS contract_amount_total
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = 'CUSTOMER'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY contract_amount_total DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ph.carrying_amount - ph.fair_value), 2) AS 倒挂金额合计,
    COUNT(*) AS 构成倒挂的持仓笔数
FROM product_holding_snapshot ph
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = ph.product_id
WHERE ph.carrying_amount > ph.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(ph.carrying_amount - ph.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 倒挂金额合计 DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
      AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.holding_id,
    phs.carrying_amount
ORDER BY
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC,
    phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS 第一顺位有效记录数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 超过百分之六十的记录数
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 超过百分之六十的记录数 DESC, cl.collateral_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    f.total_assets,
    f.total_liabilities,
    f.net_assets,
    f.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY f.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(f.total_liabilities * 1.0 / f.total_assets, 4) AS asset_liability_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE f.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY asset_liability_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    c.institution_id,
    ROUND(c.tier1_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot c
WHERE c.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC, c.institution_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / f.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND f.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND f.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

WITH inst_fin AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
      AND fs.annual_revenue > 0
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    ROUND(annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue,
    ROUND(annual_revenue * 1.0 / SUM(annual_revenue) OVER (), 2) AS ratio
FROM inst_fin
WHERE annual_revenue * 1.0 / SUM(annual_revenue) OVER () > 0.15
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC, i.institution_id;

SELECT
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE ma.valuation_method IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cd_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3.0
GROUP BY i.institution_id
ORDER BY cd_count DESC, i.institution_id;

SELECT
    so.authority_level AS authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sa.staff_id = so.staff_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'TELLER'
  AND sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE a.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH provision_gap AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS total_shortfall
    FROM provision_snapshot p
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
net_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    pg.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(pg.total_shortfall, 2) AS total_shortfall,
    nc.net_capital,
    ROUND(pg.total_shortfall * 1.0 / nc.net_capital, 2) AS shortfall_ratio
FROM provision_gap pg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = pg.institution_id
JOIN net_capital nc ON nc.institution_id = pg.institution_id
ORDER BY shortfall_ratio DESC, pg.institution_id;

SELECT
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 借据数量
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE
    rc.classification_basis = '人工认定'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, cg.grade_name_zh;

WITH bad_loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS bad_loan_count,
        ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement a ON a.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
fin_data AS (
    SELECT 
        party_id,
        annual_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    b.institution_id,
    b.bad_loan_count,
    b.total_overdue_principal
FROM bad_loan_stats b
JOIN fin_data f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || b.institution_id
WHERE b.total_overdue_principal > f.annual_revenue * 0.5
ORDER BY b.total_overdue_principal DESC;

WITH loan_principal AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(lp.total_principal, 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS 风险加权资产,
    ROUND(lp.total_principal * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS 贷款占风险加权资产百分比
FROM loan_principal lp
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = lp.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = lp.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cs.currency_code = 'CNY' -- 假设主要币种为CNY，若需多币种需进一步聚合，通常监管报表以本位币或特定币种为准，此处取最新或指定快照
ORDER BY 贷款占风险加权资产百分比 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM payment_instruction pi
INNER JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY cnt DESC, pi.payment_mode;

WITH inst_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        r.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS abnormal_cnt,
        ROUND(SUM(r.amount_value), 2) AS abnormal_amount
    FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 r
    WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
),
fin_data AS (
    SELECT 
        fs.party_id,
        ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM financial_snapshot fs
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = SUBSTR(fs.party_id, 4) AND cs.as_of_date = fs.as_of_date
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    im.abnormal_cnt,
    im.abnormal_amount,
    fd.net_capital,
    fd.total_assets,
    ROUND(im.abnormal_amount * 1.0 / fd.net_capital * 100, 4) AS ratio_pct
FROM inst_metrics im
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = im.institution_id
JOIN fin_data fd ON fd.party_id = 'PTY-' || im.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio_pct DESC;

WITH provision_gap AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.agreement_id,
        ld.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS gap_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ld.institution_id
),
inst_provision AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(loan_count) AS insufficient_loan_count,
        SUM(gap_amount) AS total_gap_amount
    FROM provision_gap
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
regulatory_overdue AS (
    SELECT 
        r.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_count,
        ROUND(AVG(r.amount_value), 2) AS avg_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
    WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ro.overdue_count,
    ro.avg_amount,
    ip.insufficient_loan_count,
    ip.total_gap_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN inst_provision ip ON ip.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN regulatory_overdue ro ON ro.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ro.overdue_count >= 25
ORDER BY ip.total_gap_amount DESC;

WITH facility_stat AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS facility_count
    FROM credit_facility
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
governance_stat AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount,
        ROUND(AVG(ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
    FROM governance_control_record_v3
    GROUP BY institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.facility_count,
    gs.exception_amount,
    gs.avg_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN governance_stat gs ON gs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN facility_stat fs ON fs.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY gs.exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT p.display_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS kind_cnt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_cnt
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 r
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = r.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = r.subject_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY target_cnt DESC, kind_cnt DESC, p.display_name;

WITH card_stat AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        COUNT(pc.card_id) AS valid_card_cnt,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS cardholder_cnt
    FROM payment_card pc
    JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
),
risk_stat AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_risk_cnt,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN exception_flag = 1 THEN amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS risk_except_amount
    FROM operational_risk_event_v3
    WHERE status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.valid_card_cnt,
    cs.cardholder_cnt,
    rs.risk_except_amount,
    rs.valid_risk_cnt
FROM institution i
JOIN card_stat cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_stat rs ON rs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.valid_risk_cnt >= 43
ORDER BY rs.risk_except_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH product_stat AS (
    SELECT 
        wp.issuer_institution_id AS institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS active_product_cnt,
        ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS actual_raise_total
    FROM wealth_product wp
    WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
    GROUP BY wp.issuer_institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ps.active_product_cnt,
    ps.actual_raise_total,
    COUNT(*) AS event_records,
    ROUND(AVG(r.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM product_conduct_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
JOIN product_stat ps ON ps.institution_id = r.institution_id
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, ps.active_product_cnt, ps.actual_raise_total
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY ps.actual_raise_total DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH asset_stat AS (
    SELECT 
        ma.originator_institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS asset_count,
        ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount
    FROM managed_asset ma
    GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
),
custody_stat AS (
    SELECT 
        co.event_code,
        co.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_record_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN co.exception_flag = 1 THEN co.amount_value ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal_amount_sum
    FROM custody_operation_event_v3 co
    WHERE co.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY co.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    a.asset_count,
    a.total_issued_amount,
    c.valid_record_count,
    ROUND(c.abnormal_amount_sum, 2) AS abnormal_amount_sum
FROM institution i
JOIN asset_stat a ON a.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN custody_stat c ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE c.valid_record_count > 0 AND c.abnormal_amount_sum > 0 -- 隐含条件：异常金额合计通常指有异常记录，且题目要求异常记录数>=2
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, a.asset_count, a.total_issued_amount, c.valid_record_count, c.abnormal_amount_sum
HAVING c.valid_record_count >= 2
ORDER BY a.total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name;
